capabilities: Sync a vault between devices through your own Cloudflare Worker with end-to-end encryption
Resolve conflicts with diff views, merge options, and an optional newest-wins policy
Browse and restore snapshot history by day, week, or individual sync
Expose the vault to Claude, Codex, or other MCP clients through an optional, separately deployed agent Worker
Manage access and admin tokens, multiple vault deployments, and deny rules for the agent
extras: You deploy and maintain your own Worker, R2 bucket, and Durable Object; the Cloudflare free plan is enough. Limits include 100 MiB per file and 100,000 files per snapshot. AGPL-3.0-or-later license, provided as-is without warranty; snapshot history is explicitly not a backup.
intentEvidence: Not affiliated with Obsidian, and not the official sync service.
problem: Vault syncing normally depends on a paid official service or plugins that guess from timestamps, with no encrypted option on infrastructure you control.
